say:1:1321817001:1.text: General Valka, you seem troubled. What's wrong?
say:1:1321817001:1.source_cn: 瓦丽卡女士，你匆忙来此，是出了什么事情？

say:2:1321817002:2.text: I sensed Hypogean magic... and it led me here. So I wasn't mistaken after all.
say:2:1321817002:2.source_cn: 我察觉到了恶魔的魔法气息……看来这似乎并不是我的错觉。

say:3:1321817003:0.text: Why do you look so surprised, Faramor?
say:3:1321817003:0.source_cn: 怎么了，法拉莫尔先生，这样看着我。

say:4:1321817004:0.text: I didn't realize you could sense magic from such a distance.
say:4:1321817004:0.source_cn: 我……只是有些惊讶，您能在这么远的距离捕捉到气息。

say:5:1321817005:1.text: The Graveborn here were created to repel the Hypogeans... However, some of us have forgotten our duty over time.
say:5:1321817005:1.source_cn: 白山的亡灵是为了对抗恶魔才诞生的……只是时间太久，有些...

say:6:1321817006:1.text: If my instincts are correct, their minions have returned.
say:6:1321817006:1.source_cn: 我没猜错的话，恶魔眷属又出现了？

say:7:1321817007:1.text: Indeed, a man was killed nearby. The characteristics of his wounds suggest he was struck down by Hypogean magic.
say:7:1321817007:1.source_cn: 是的，有位远道而来的男士在这附近遇害了，看他伤口的特征...

say:8:1321817008:1.text: May he find eternal peace in the divine realm.
say:8:1321817008:1.source_cn: 那位先生……希望他能在神的国度中永享安宁。

say:9:1321817009:1.text: The Frost Furie's influence never truly faded from this land, not since the First Divine War.
say:9:1321817009:1.source_cn: 从第一次神魔战争到现在，冰之恶魔带来的影响直到现在还没...

say:10:1321817010:1.text: The last time the Hypogean minions ran rampant was twenty years ago—a vengeful slaughter against the families of the war's heroes.
say:10:1321817010:1.source_cn: 我记得……上一次大量出现恶魔眷属伤人的事件还是二十年前...

say:11:1321817011:1.text: Many of them were wiped out, including branches of the Radinov and Valesa families.
say:11:1321817011:1.source_cn: 很多家族都因此绝嗣，拉季诺夫家族和瓦勒沙家族的一些旁支...

choice_prompt:12:1321817011.text: Many of them were wiped out, including branches of the Radinov and Valesa families.
choice_prompt:12:1321817011.source_cn: 很多家族都因此绝嗣，拉季诺夫家族和瓦勒沙家族的一些旁支就是这样。

say:13:1321817012:1.text: You suspect the victim was targeted?
say:13:1321817012:1.source_cn: 你是好奇为什么那个男子会被袭击？
say:13:1321817012:1.male: You suspect the victim was targeted?
say:13:1321817012:1.female: You suspect the victim was targeted?

choice_prompt:14:1321817012.female: You suspect the victim was targeted?

say:15:1321817014:1.text: Are you saying the man might be the descendant of one of the heroes from the First Divine War?
say:15:1321817014:1.source_cn: 照这样说，之前那位被袭击的男士，或许真有可能是参加过第...

say:17:1321817016:1.text: We should speak to Orla—but first, we must <style="highlight">eliminate these Hypogean minions</style> before they claim another life.
say:17:1321817016:1.source_cn: 或许我们应该去找奥尔嘉问问。但为了保证她的安全，我们有...

say:18:1321817017:1.text: They're probably still lurking nearby. If we search together, we can find them for sure.
say:18:1321817017:1.source_cn: 它们或许还潜伏在附近，我们一起寻找，一定能找到。

choice:14:0:1.text: Could he be from those families?
choice:14:0:1.source_cn: 难道他也是英雄家族的后裔？
choice:14:0:1.male: Could he be from those families?
choice:14:0:1.female: Could he be from those families?

say:20:1321817013:1.text: Right. The Hypogean minions have the scent of the heroes' blood seared into their memories. Even after thousands of years, they still mercilessly exact their revenge on their descendants.
say:20:1321817013:1.source_cn: 正是。恶魔眷属们记住了他们血脉中的“气味”，即便过了千...

choice:12:1:2.source_cn: 受袭者家族都参加过第一次神魔大战？
